t: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–335, $32,100,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This section only rescinds $32,100,000 of previously appropriated funds under Public Law 103-335. There is no tempting contrary reading: it involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation provision that rescinds (cancels) a specific amount of funding. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–335, $32,100,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: The provision just cancels $32,100,000 of funds that were previously appropriated. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, or right to sue, and it involves no party outside the federal government. Mentioning a public law does not create any process for outsiders to take part.

However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
